artifact_observations.reasoning: The bookcase exhibits significant warping and bending, particularly on the right side where the vertical support seems to melt into the background/wall. The shelves do not maintain straight lines, curving unnaturally. This could be extreme wide-angle lens distortion, but the inconsistency suggests AI generation artifacts or severe structural collapse.

The spines of the books lack distinct text and clear boundaries. They appear as smeared color blocks rather than individual books with sharp edges. Some books seem to fuse with the shelf or each other.

artifact_observations.location: Top right corner and right vertical edge
artifact_observations.reasoning: The top right corner of the bookcase loses definition and seems to blend into the ceiling/wall. The vertical edge on the right is not a straight line but wavers and thickens inconsistently, indicating a failure in maintaining rigid geometric structure.
There is inconsistent blur across the image. Some areas are sharper than others without a clear depth-of-field logic, suggesting generative blur rather than optical blur.
